name: Mariana Pimentel (Brazil)
description: Three diagonal stripes of light green, golden yellow and light blue descending from the hoist towards the fly.
history: Mariana Pimentel is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were prescribed by Municipal Law No. 96 of 9 December 1994, which places the municipal arms at the centre of the flag; the Wikimedia Commons drawing omits them.

features.role: green upper hoist and blue lower fly
